"""Fixture (h): rewritten module's own tests pass after codemod."""

from agent_workflows import artifact_meta


def _spec_text(spec_id: str, status: str) -> str:
    return (
        f"# Spec: Pass Check {spec_id}\n\n"
        f"- Id: {spec_id}\n"
        f"- Status: {status}\n"
    )


def test_rewritten_plain_plan() -> None:
    text = (
        "# IPD: Pass Check Plan\n\n"
        "- Id: pl8001\n"
        "- Status: approved\n"
        "- Set: demo\n"
        "- Order: 2\n"
    )
    st = artifact_meta.read_text(text, record_type="ipd")
    assert st.id6 == "pl8001"
    assert st.status == "approved"
    assert st.fields["set"] == "demo"
    assert st.fields["order"] == "2"


def test_rewritten_fstring_spec() -> None:
    text = _spec_text("sp8002", "reviewed")
    st = artifact_meta.read_text(text, record_type="spec")
    assert st.id6 == "sp8002"
    assert st.status == "reviewed"


def test_rewritten_invalid_input_spec() -> None:
    text = (
        "# Spec: Pass Check Invalid\n\n"
        "- Id: sp8003\n"
        "- Status: EXECUTED\n"
    )
    st = artifact_meta.read_text(text, record_type="spec")
    assert st.id6 == "sp8003"
    assert st.legacy_raw_status == "EXECUTED"
